_doc1: Hand-declared framing anchors for every LIVE hero portrait (base + evolutions).
_doc2: head_top = topmost pixel of the SKULL/HELMET DOME only — never antennas, hoods, horns, spikes, icicles, halos, or glow. chin = bottom of the head.
_doc3: Declared by Kev from the measuring sheets (scripts/assets/portrait_measure_sheet.py). NEVER derive these from pixels — automated head detection is how the 2026-07-12 framing failure happened.
_doc4: Consumed by scripts/assets/portrait_frame_crop.py: scale = _target_head_height / (chin - head_top), then a fixed _crop_height window with the scaled head_top sitting _head_top_margin px below the top edge. A new portrait gets framed by adding its two numbers here and re-running the tool.
_doc5: Key = portrait file basename without .png. 2026-07-12: 'breaker_nullterre' in the hand-off was a typo for breaker_nullwire (Breaker's evolutions are noise/nullwire); anchors kept verbatim.
